text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a birthday present? What could it be, 
what could it be? It feels pretty hefty...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's a book... I heard you liked hot 
springs, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Books on the history of hot springs, 
guidebooks for onsen towns... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It might be a bit late to say this, but 
rather than a 'Hot Springs Guidebook', 
maybe bath salts or hot spring vouchers... 
would have been way better, right!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I ended up picking it based purely on my 
own taste...! I'm so sorry for being so 
thoughtless............

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no no no! I'm honestly super happy 
about it!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, for my birthday, Hishi Miracle-san 
gave me an eye mask for eye fatigue, 
herbal tea, and...—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even though you gave me a gift that 
showed such thoughtful consideration for 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was just because I happen to be a 
relaxation goods maniac, so I simply 
picked from what I know~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A gift that plays to my strengths can't go 
wrong... probably! Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So Robroy-chan's book recommendations are 
bound to be super interesting! Ehehe, I 
can't wait~♪
